decisions.reason: The accepted Option A also governs tip submission, but a complete same-message MODIFY already records the separate tip button and disables automatic tip transaction prompts.
The decision concerns success-modal controls for no-code random-referral finalization and does not change fiat-buyer wallet creation, custody, holdings, or access.
The decision does not change the Transak provider, fiat conversion, payment methods, or automatic minting after conversion.
Changing how a no-code random referral is finalized does not alter the $15 primary-mint revenue allocation.
The separate post-mint finalization control does not change the connected-wallet USDC payment and NFT-mint flow.
Option A specifies success-modal transaction controls but does not require a change to FAQ copy; the existing descriptions of eventual no-referral allocation remain valid.
The decision does not change ETH pricing, swapping, shortfall behavior, or NFT mint execution.
Disabling automatic post-mint follow-up prompts does not change disclosure or selection of ETH, USDC, or card payment methods.
The decision affects a follow-up reward-finalization transaction, not whether successful NFT mint transactions are authoritatively recorded.
The no-referral finalization UX does not change the method or currency used to refund excess ETH payment value.
The source accepts a success-modal interaction design and does not direct changes to About-page content; eventual random reward allocation remains accurately described.

Manual initiation of random-referral finalization does not alter the requirement to display commissions once awarded or to reconcile completed random allocations; no visibility rule is changed by Option A.
